verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for a SaaS scheduling product with a first-party MCP endpoint, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of an isolated sandbox, test account or non-production calendar. The closest item, "Preview changes in your calendar before deploying them," is a dry-run style preview inside the live calendar, not sandbox isolation from production data, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
